---
title: "Quarto websites cheat sheet"
---

## Commands

| Task | Command |
|---|---|
| Check your setup | `quarto check` |
| Create a website project | `quarto create project website my-site` |
| Live preview while editing | `quarto preview` (stop with **Ctrl + C**) |
| Build the whole site | `quarto render` |
| Build one page | `quarto render page.qmd` |

## Editor shortcuts

| Action | Positron / VS Code | RStudio |
|---|---|---|
| Command Palette | Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + P | n/a |
| Create a project | Command Palette → **Quarto: Create Project** | **File → New Project → New Directory → Quarto Website** |
| Preview | Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + K | **Render** button (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + K) |
| Render whole site | `quarto render` in the terminal | **Build** tab → **Render Website** |
| Visual editor | Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + F4 | **Visual** button |

## Page header

```yaml
---
title: "Page title"
description: "One-line summary"
---
```

## Minimal website `_quarto.yml`

```yaml
project:
  type: website
  output-dir: docs
  resources:
    - "/.nojekyll"

website:
  title: "My Site"
  search: true
  page-navigation: true
  navbar:
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - href: lessons/01-intro.qmd
        text: Lessons
  sidebar:
    style: docked
    contents:
      - section: "Lessons"
        contents: "lessons/*"
  page-footer:
    center: "Questions? [me@example.gov](mailto:me@example.gov)"

format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: cosmo
      dark: darkly
    respect-user-color-scheme: true
    toc: true
    code-copy: true
```

## R chunks

````markdown
```{r}
#| label: fig-cases
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Describe the chart's type, variables, and main pattern."
plot(cases)
```

Inline result: `{r} nrow(cases)` cases.
````

| Chunk option | Effect |
|---|---|
| `echo: false` | Hide code, show result |
| `eval: false` | Show code, don't run it |
| `include: false` | Run, show nothing |
| `warning: false` | Hide warnings |
| `fig-alt` | Alt text for a chart (required) |
| `fig-cap` | Visible caption |

Freeze results so code only re-runs when it changes (commit `_freeze/`):

```yaml
execute:
  freeze: auto
```

## Publish to GitHub Pages

1. `output-dir: docs` in `_quarto.yml`, plus an empty `.nojekyll` file
2. `quarto render`
3. Commit everything, **including `docs/`**, and push
4. Repo **Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → `main` → `/docs` → Save**

**Every update:** edit → `quarto render` → commit (with `docs/`) → push.

## Before you publish

- [ ] No real data, credentials, or internal details (Pages sites are public)
- [ ] Every image and chart has alt text
- [ ] Previewed in light and dark mode; links work
- [ ] Rendered, and `docs/` committed
